annotations.title: Resolve DNS for up to 25 hostnames

description: Resolve DNS for up to 25 hostnames — Bulk DNS: resolve up to 25 hostnames for up to 4 record types (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA, CAA; default A) in one call via DNS-over-HTTPS. Returns records per name, which names do not resolve, IPs shared between names and (with MX) the mail provider each domain uses. Pass ?names= (comma-separated) and optional &types=A,MX. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: dns_lookup_batch
